name: Wei Jun Jie
bio: Wei's fascination with motorsport began during his mandatory national service, where he worked on vehicle maintenance. This ignited a passion for the mechanical aspects of racing. Following his service, he pursued a diploma in mechanical engineering, focusing on aerodynamics and fluid dynamics. His internship at a local engineering firm involved computational fluid dynamics, which naturally led him to seek a role in Formula racing. He is known for his meticulous approach to data analysis, always seeking to validate simulations with real-world wind tunnel results. Wei is determined to optimise vehicle performance through understanding of aerodynamic principles.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed, with a slight quiff at the front
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and data points.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when concentrating.
Insists on double-checking all equipment calibrations before starting a wind tunnel session.
